agyos_skill.instructions: Systematic protocol for keeping every skill in the AGYOS catalog accurate, current, and internally consistent. Triggered whenever a user correction arrives, new industry data surfaces, or a skill change ripples into dependents. - A user corrects, refines, or extends any existing AGYOS skill - Research reveals new techniques, deprecations, or industry shifts relevant to a skill - A skill update creates stale cross-references in dependent skills - End-of-session reconciliation of all changes applied during the conversation When a user provides a correction, addition, or refinement to any skill, execute every step in order. Append an entry to `.agents/state/corrections/CORRECTIONS_LOG.md` with this structure: ```markdown - **Category**: <category> - **Section**: <section heading or "frontmatter"> - **Before**: ``` <verbatim text replaced> ``` - **After**: ``` <verbatim replacement text> ``` - **Rationale**: <one-line reason for the change> ``` Assign exactly one category per correction entry: | Category | Use When | |---|---| | `factual_fix` | Incorrect information replaced with verified data | | `principle_addition` | New principle, pattern, or technique added |
